tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search Vid Kraken's API docs, endpoint references, MCP guide, pricing and blog guides (YouTube downloads, yt-dlp errors, formats). Returns the best-matching pages with a snippet and their Markdown URL; read one in full with get_doc.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Return one Vid Kraken page as Markdown, by path or URL: e.g. /docs, /docs/endpoint/submit-download, /docs/mcp, /pricing, /about, /blog/<slug>. Use search_docs to find paths.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_docs, get_doc · Public sink: get_doc.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_docs, get_doc · Public sink: get_doc

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
